_comment: NovoMCP-Compound-Screen-v1: compound-library quality checks, physicochemical and ADMET screening summaries, and three repeated candidate-scoring input scans. Generated from the NovoMCP Open Corpus Lite compounds schema; not an end-to-end MCP-agent evaluation or docking run.
1: SELECT count(*) AS n_compounds, approx_count_distinct(cid) AS approx_distinct_cid, avg(molecular_weight) AS avg_molecular_weight, avg(qed) AS avg_qed FROM compounds
2: SELECT count(*) AS n_compounds, 1.0 - count(smiles) / count(*) AS null_rate_smiles, 1.0 - count(molecular_formula) / count(*) AS null_rate_formula, 1.0 - count(xlogp) / count(*) AS null_rate_xlogp, 1.0 - count(fsp3) / count(*) AS null_rate_fsp3, 1.0 - count(hba) / count(*) AS null_rate_hba, 1.0 - count(hbd) / count(*) AS null_rate_hbd, 1.0 - count(qed) / count(*) AS null_rate_qed, 1.0 - count(binding_affinity_score) / count(*) AS null_rate_binding_affinity FROM compounds
3: SELECT min(molecular_weight) AS min_molecular_weight, max(molecular_weight) AS max_molecular_weight, avg(molecular_weight) AS avg_molecular_weight, stddev(molecular_weight) AS std_molecular_weight, min(tpsa) AS min_tpsa, max(tpsa) AS max_tpsa, avg(tpsa) AS avg_tpsa, stddev(tpsa) AS std_tpsa, min(complexity) AS min_complexity, max(complexity) AS max_complexity, avg(complexity) AS avg_complexity, stddev(complexity) AS std_complexity, avg(CAST(hba AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_hba, avg(CAST(hbd AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_hbd, avg(rotatable_bonds) AS avg_rotatable_bonds FROM compounds
4: SELECT count(*) AS n_compounds, sum(CASE WHEN molecular_weight BETWEEN 150 AND 600 AND xlogp BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND tpsa <= 140 AND CAST(hba AS DOUBLE) <= 10 AND CAST(hbd AS DOUBLE) <= 5 AND rotatable_bonds <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lipinski_like, avg(CASE WHEN molecular_weight BETWEEN 150 AND 600 AND xlogp BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND tpsa <= 140 AND CAST(hba AS DOUBLE) <= 10 AND CAST(hbd AS DOUBLE) <= 5 AND rotatable_bonds <= 10 THEN qed END) AS lipinski_like_avg_qed FROM compounds
5: SELECT CASE WHEN molecular_weight < 200 THEN 'lt_200' WHEN molecular_weight < 400 THEN '200_399' WHEN molecular_weight < 600 THEN '400_599' WHEN molecular_weight < 800 THEN '600_799' ELSE 'ge_800' END AS mw_bucket, CASE WHEN xlogp IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN xlogp < 1 THEN 'lt_1' WHEN xlogp < 3 THEN '1_3' WHEN xlogp < 5 THEN '3_5' ELSE 'ge_5' END AS xlogp_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(qed) AS avg_qed, avg(overall_toxicity_score) AS avg_toxicity FROM compounds GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY mw_bucket, xlogp_bucket
6: SELECT CASE WHEN qed IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN qed < 0.2 THEN 'lt_02' WHEN qed < 0.4 THEN '02_04' WHEN qed < 0.6 THEN '04_06' WHEN qed < 0.8 THEN '06_08' ELSE 'ge_08' END AS qed_bucket, CASE WHEN synthetic_accessibility IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN synthetic_accessibility < 3 THEN 'easy' WHEN synthetic_accessibility < 5 THEN 'moderate' WHEN synthetic_accessibility < 7 THEN 'hard' ELSE 'very_hard' END AS sa_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(drug_likeness) AS avg_drug_likeness FROM compounds GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY qed_bucket, sa_bucket
7: SELECT CASE WHEN hba IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN CAST(hba AS DOUBLE) <= 2 THEN 'le_2' WHEN CAST(hba AS DOUBLE) <= 5 THEN '3_5' WHEN CAST(hba AS DOUBLE) <= 10 THEN '6_10' ELSE 'gt_10' END AS hba_bucket, CASE WHEN hbd IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN CAST(hbd AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 'zero' WHEN CAST(hbd AS DOUBLE) <= 2 THEN '1_2' WHEN CAST(hbd AS DOUBLE) <= 5 THEN '3_5' ELSE 'gt_5' END AS hbd_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(tpsa) AS avg_tpsa FROM compounds GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY hba_bucket, hbd_bucket
8: SELECT pains_severity, has_pains, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(qed) AS avg_qed, avg(synthetic_accessibility) AS avg_synthetic_accessibility, avg(overall_toxicity_score) AS avg_toxicity FROM compounds GROUP BY pains_severity, has_pains ORDER BY pains_severity, has_pains
9: SELECT CASE WHEN overall_toxicity_score IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN overall_toxicity_score < 0.3 THEN 'low' WHEN overall_toxicity_score < 0.6 THEN 'medium' WHEN overall_toxicity_score < 0.8 THEN 'high' ELSE 'very_high' END AS toxicity_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(ames_mutagenicity_probability) AS avg_ames, avg(hepatotoxicity_probability) AS avg_hepatotoxicity, avg(herg_blocker_probability) AS avg_herg, avg(carcinogenicity_probability) AS avg_carcinogenicity FROM compounds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY toxicity_bucket
10: SELECT avg(cyp1a2_inhibitor_probability) AS avg_cyp1a2_inhibitor, avg(cyp2c9_inhibitor_probability) AS avg_cyp2c9_inhibitor, avg(cyp2c19_inhibitor_probability) AS avg_cyp2c19_inhibitor, avg(cyp2d6_inhibitor_probability) AS avg_cyp2d6_inhibitor, avg(cyp3a4_inhibitor_probability) AS avg_cyp3a4_inhibitor, avg(cyp2c9_substrate_probability) AS avg_cyp2c9_substrate, avg(cyp2d6_substrate_probability) AS avg_cyp2d6_substrate, avg(cyp3a4_substrate_probability) AS avg_cyp3a4_substrate, avg(cyp_inhibition_risk_score) AS avg_cyp_risk, avg(cyp_substrate_max_probability) AS avg_cyp_substrate_max FROM compounds
11: SELECT CASE WHEN bioavailability_probability IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN bioavailability_probability < 0.6 THEN 'lt_06' WHEN bioavailability_probability < 0.8 THEN '06_08' WHEN bioavailability_probability < 0.9 THEN '08_09' ELSE 'ge_09' END AS bioavailability_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(hia_probability) AS avg_hia, avg(caco2_permeability) AS avg_caco2, avg(bbb_penetration_probability) AS avg_bbb, avg(ppbr_percent) AS avg_ppbr, avg(vdss_l_kg) AS avg_vdss, avg(half_life_hr) AS avg_half_life FROM compounds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY bioavailability_bucket
12: SELECT pmod(hash(coalesce(molecular_formula, '__NULL__')), 1024) AS formula_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(molecular_weight) AS avg_molecular_weight, avg(qed) AS avg_qed FROM compounds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n_compounds DESC, formula_bucket ASC LIMIT 1000
13: SELECT CASE WHEN length(smiles) < 20 THEN 'lt_20' WHEN length(smiles) < 40 THEN '20_39' WHEN length(smiles) < 80 THEN '40_79' WHEN length(smiles) < 160 THEN '80_159' ELSE 'ge_160' END AS smiles_length_bucket, CASE WHEN length(molecular_formula) < 10 THEN 'lt_10' WHEN length(molecular_formula) < 20 THEN '10_19' ELSE 'ge_20' END AS formula_length_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(complexity) AS avg_complexity, avg(binding_affinity_score) AS avg_binding_affinity, sum(length(coalesce(pains_types, ''))) AS pains_type_chars FROM compounds GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY smiles_length_bucket, formula_length_bucket
14: SELECT CASE WHEN binding_affinity_score IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN binding_affinity_score < 0.001 THEN 'lt_0001' WHEN binding_affinity_score < 0.1 THEN '0001_01' WHEN binding_affinity_score < 0.9 THEN '01_09' ELSE 'ge_09' END AS affinity_bucket, count(*) AS n_compounds, avg(qed) AS avg_qed, avg(drug_likeness) AS avg_drug_likeness, avg(overall_toxicity_score) AS avg_toxicity, avg(cyp_inhibition_risk_score) AS avg_cyp_risk FROM compounds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY affinity_bucket
15: SELECT count(*) AS n_candidates, avg(molecular_weight) AS avg_molecular_weight, avg(xlogp) AS avg_xlogp, avg(tpsa) AS avg_tpsa, avg(qed) AS avg_qed, avg(binding_affinity_score) AS avg_binding_affinity FROM compounds WHERE molecular_weight BETWEEN 200 AND 550 AND xlogp BETWEEN 1 AND 4.5 AND tpsa BETWEEN 20 AND 120 AND qed >= 0.5 AND overall_toxicity_score < 0.6 AND cyp_inhibition_risk_score < 0.4 AND has_pains = false
16: SELECT count(*) AS n_compounds, sum(CASE WHEN molecular_weight BETWEEN 200 AND 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mw_in_range, sum(CASE WHEN xlogp BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS xlogp_in_range, sum(CASE WHEN tpsa <= 140 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tpsa_in_range, sum(CASE WHEN qed >= 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_qed, sum(CASE WHEN has_pains = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_pains, sum(CASE WHEN overall_toxicity_score < 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptable_toxicity, sum(CASE WHEN bioavailability_probability >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_bioavailability FROM compounds
17: SELECT sum(CAST(cid AS BIGINT)) AS cid_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(molecular_weight, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS molecular_weight_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(tpsa, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS tpsa_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(complexity, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS complexity_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(fsp3, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS fsp3_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hba, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hba_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hbd, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hbd_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(qed, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS qed_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(drug_likeness, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS drug_likeness_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(binding_affinity_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS binding_affinity_sum, sum(length(smiles)) AS smiles_chars, sum(length(molecular_formula)) AS formula_chars, sum(length(coalesce(pains_types, ''))) AS pains_type_chars FROM compounds
18: SELECT count(*) AS n_compounds, sum(CAST(coalesce(molecular_weight, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS molecular_weight_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(xlogp, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS xlogp_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(tpsa, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS tpsa_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(complexity, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS complexity_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(fsp3, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS fsp3_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hba, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hba_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hbd, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hbd_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(rotatable_bonds, 0) AS BIGINT)) AS rotatable_bonds_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(qed, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS qed_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(drug_likeness, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS drug_likeness_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(synthetic_accessibility, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS synthetic_accessibility_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(bioavailability_probability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS bioavailability_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hia_probability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hia_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(caco2_permeability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS caco2_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(bbb_penetration_probability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS bbb_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(cyp_inhibition_risk_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS cyp_risk_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(overall_toxicity_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS toxicity_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(binding_affinity_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS binding_affinity_sum, sum(length(smiles)) AS smiles_chars, sum(length(molecular_formula)) AS formula_chars, sum(length(pains_severity)) AS pains_severity_chars, sum(length(coalesce(pains_types, ''))) AS pains_type_chars FROM compounds
19: SELECT count(*) AS n_compounds, sum(CAST(coalesce(molecular_weight, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS molecular_weight_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(xlogp, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS xlogp_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(tpsa, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS tpsa_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(complexity, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS complexity_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(fsp3, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS fsp3_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hba, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hba_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hbd, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hbd_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(rotatable_bonds, 0) AS BIGINT)) AS rotatable_bonds_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(qed, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS qed_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(drug_likeness, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS drug_likeness_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(synthetic_accessibility, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS synthetic_accessibility_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(bioavailability_probability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS bioavailability_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(hia_probability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS hia_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(caco2_permeability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS caco2_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(bbb_penetration_probability, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS bbb_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(cyp_inhibition_risk_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS cyp_risk_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(overall_toxicity_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS toxicity_sum, sum(CAST(coalesce(binding_affinity_score, 0.0) AS DOUBLE)) AS binding_affinity_sum, sum(length(smiles)) AS smiles_chars, sum(length(molecular_formula)) AS formula_chars, sum(length(pains_severity)) AS pains_severity_chars, sum(length(coalesce(pains_types, ''))) AS pains_type_chars FROM compounds
